header: "Who are the PhD holders?" (step 56b). The employee directory holds no qualification. The system knows its PhD holders from ONE source: the list I keep by hand, DR_TICKETS in employees/honorific.ts (a non-medical employee with a PhD who writes "Dr." before the name). Before this step such a question went to the circulars: on 26 Oct 2026 "name of the employee who is phd holder" answered "Dr. Partha Mukhopadhyay" from the circular "List of Nodal Officers ... for SIR", labelled "PhD holder" only because the name carries "Dr." and with the designation of December 2025 (Jr. Mgr.): the right person by accident, a nodal officer's column read as a qualification, and no way to know of anybody else. Now I answer the question from the list itself, by ticket, from the directory (designation and department as they are today), with the plain statement that the list is kept by hand and may be incomplete. No model call, so nothing can be misread. This takes only a question that asks WHO the PhD holders are. A question about a policy, a scholarship, leave, a circular ..., or one that names a department ("PhD holders in electrical"), is not taken: a department filter would need the department of each person, and I do not want the list to answer another department's question with the one person it has.
